name: Honda NSX (NA1, 1990: pop-up head lamps, 3.0 L C30A V6 DOHC VTEC, 274 PS, coupe with the black roof)
axes: mm; x from the nose tip (0) back to the tail (4405); y half-width from the centre line (symmetric, positive; parts on one side only say so); z from the ground at static ride height

tolerance.overall: makers' figures for the 1990 car: exact (length 4405, width 1810, height 1170, wheelbase 2530, tracks 1510/1530, tyres)
tolerance.overhangs: +-20: 930/945 split read on the blueprint side (axle-to-nose 149.5 px, axle-to-tail 151.5 px at 6.13 mm/px), stretched to the 1875 total; Honda's own drawing (later 4430 car) gives the same front 930
tolerance.profile: +-25 in z, +-30 in x on the centre line; the deck and spoiler +-30 (sources disagree by 20-40 there)
tolerance.plan: +-25: the blueprint plan, 6.23 mm/px along, 6.37 across (the plan is drawn 2 % long for its width)
tolerance.lines: belt, crease, skirt, door lines: +-25 (blueprint side, checked on photos)
tolerance.parts: +-40 for parts read on the drawings; +-60 for those placed from photographs only (rear side marker, intake depth, engine bay contents)
tolerance.frontRearViews: blueprint front and rear views: widths +-30 (scaled by the tracks); their heights are squashed 10-12 % and were used only for order and layout, the z values come from the side view

sources: makers' data for the 1990 NA1 (Acura/Honda via Wikipedia, cararac, thecarspec, parkers, auto-data): 4405 x 1810 x 1170, wheelbase 2530, tracks 1510/1530, tyres 205/50 ZR15 on 6.5JJx15 front, 225/50 ZR16 on 8JJx16 rear, ground clearance 135 (5.3 in)

Honda's dimensioned drawing (dims_drawing.png): 4430 long, 1160 high, rear track 1540 = the later car (1997-2005 figures); used for the cabin figures, ground clearance at the floor (125) and as a check of the profile; not for the 1990 overall figures

blueprint 4-view (blueprint_4view_blue_NA2text.png): its text is about the 3.2 L car but the drawing is a 1990-type body (five-spoke 15/16 in wheels, pop-up covers, the low spoiler): the main source for profile, lines, plan and parts
model-copy 4-view: the same drawing family (feature check only)
Hum3D renders of the 2002 fixed-lamp car: tail lamp layout, deck and spoiler heights (common body only)
grey 3D model, two three-quarter views: engine bay under the (removed) rear glass, the cabin back window, the boot lid
wireframe front (perspective): the panel split of the nose (bonnet between two shut lines, the cover outlines, bumper lamps, three intakes)

photographs of the 1990-type car (red front three-quarter x2, red rear three-quarter from above, green Type R front): the black canopy, B pillar, quarter glass, rear glass foot, the intake, fuel flap, tail band, bumper lamps

drawingChecks._: the corrections_138 lesson: each drawing's scale checked per axis before use
drawingChecks.blueprintSide: wheel centres px (220.5, 245.5) and (633.5, 244.5): wheelbase 412.5 px -> 6.133 mm/px along; tyres round (r 50.5 px across, 50 px up); ground row 295.5, roof row 96. At the x scale the roof would stand 1224 (real 1170): the drawing is 4.6 % tall for its length. z scaled by the height: 5.865 mm/px. Nose px 71, tail px 785 (4379 at the x scale, 0.6 % short): overhangs mapped piecewise so the tail lands on 4405
drawingChecks.hondaDrawing: wheel centres px 117.5 / 277.5 (wheelbase 160 px -> 15.8 mm/px); 4430 line spans 281 px (15.77): x consistent. Roof 70 px above the ground = 1103 at that scale against the labelled 1160: squashed 5 % in z, so z scaled at 16.57 mm/px. Its '830' rear figure ends at px 330 = the rear lamp face, not the bumper (the bumper ends at px 339); its '1050' runs from the front axle to the 1962 mark (not a front overhang)
drawingChecks.blueprintPlan: length 707 px, widest 284 px: 6.23 mm/px along (4405), 6.37 across (1810); centre column 246
drawingChecks.blueprintFront: track line 240 px = 1510 -> 6.29 mm/px across; roof to tyre foot 206 px for 1170 = 5.68 mm/px: squashed 10 % in z
drawingChecks.blueprintRear: track line 240 px = 1530 -> 6.375 across; height 5.65 mm/px: squashed 12 %
drawingChecks.hum3d: side view: wheelbase 168 px -> 15.1 mm/px but roof 72 px above the ground = 1080 against 1160: squashed 7 %, z scaled by height
drawingChecks.wireframeFront: perspective (the nose's features too wide by 5-10 % against the plan): split of panels only
drawingChecks.lengthChoice: 4405 for 1990: the Acura/Honda NA1 figure quoted by most sources; 4425 (auto-data, 1997-2001) and 4430 (the Honda drawing, 2002-05 and some JDM lists) are later cars. The overlay of the Honda drawing on the axles matches the nose to 10 mm and runs about 25 past this tail: the extra length is at the rear (later bumper and higher spoiler)

overall.groundClearanceNote: 1990 spec 135 (5.3 in); Honda's later drawing 125 at the floor's middle; the sill's foot reads 120-125 on the blueprint, the front lip 108-120

cab._: the NSX is a mid-engine 'cab forward' for its day: the screen's foot ahead of the front wheel's back edge line, the cabin in the middle of the wheelbase
cab.hipPoint: x about 2360-2400, z about 300 (the Honda drawing's 960 head-room line stands at x 2395; seat back 2500-2650); +-60
cab.hondaCabinFigures: 960 head room (vertical from the hip point), 870* along the torso, 475 (seat), 920 and 795* horizontal cabin figures, 1050 from the front axle; the * figures are with the seat in its rearmost place; meanings of 920/795 not certain, not used for geometry
cab.shares: screen foot at 25 % of the length, roof peak at 53-55 %, rear glass foot at 80 %, engine bay 61-80 %

profile._: the silhouette from the side [x, z] (the highest line across the car): top runs nose -> bonnet -> screen -> roof -> rear glass -> deck -> spoiler -> lamp face -> bumper; bottom back to the nose. Wheels not included

runs.nose: 0-50: the bumper's face, round in plan, its top at z 430 leaning back to 493 at x 50
runs.bonnet: 50-1110: a long convex slope (about 25 deg at the nose easing to 7 deg at the cowl) over the pop-up covers (x 250-630) which lie flush in it
runs.screen: 1110-2050 on the centre line at about 25 deg, curving into the roof; the corners' foot at x 1460
runs.rearGlass: 2700-3520 at about 17 deg: the big glass over the engine; black canopy down to its foot (z 878 at x 3520)
runs.deck: 3520-3950: the boot lid, nearly flat at 856-872
runs.spoiler: 3950-4300: the integrated spoiler rising from the deck to a flat top at 897 (x 4150-4290), its trailing edge at 4300
runs.tail: under the spoiler the lamp face leans forward to x 4258 at z 815 then down and back to 4290 at 640; the bumper's top at 580 steps out to the bumper face at 4405 (z 540-385)

plan._: half-width at x at the widest line (mirrors excluded); the nose is a round 'U', front wings widest at 882 (x 700-1200), a slight waist at the doors (866-873), widest at the rear wings 905 (x 3250-3350), the tail rounding in from 3750
plan.bonnetEdge: the bonnet's shut lines run from y 357 at x 150 to 452 at the cowl (x 1100), nearly straight; outboard of them the front wings' tops
plan.doorGlassFoot: y 760 at the belt (tumblehome: 12 % in from the widest line); the glass leans in to y 600 at the top
plan.rearWingRidge: the rear wings' tops stand beside the rear glass: y 750-800 at x 2800-3500, curving in to 650 at 4000 and running into the spoiler's ends

sections._: heights of the lines along the flank, [x, z]
sections.beltNote: where the black canopy meets the body colour: low at the A pillar's foot (745), lowest behind the mirror (732), rising steadily to the B pillar's base (805 at x 2750) and the quarter glass's foot (824 at 2950)
sections.crestF: the front wing's top runs with the bonnet's edge, 0-15 above the centre line's height from the covers back to the A pillar (z 765 at x 1300)
sections.doorCreaseNote: a soft horizontal crease along the door (z about 600) from behind the front wheel into the intake's top front corner
sections.skirtNote: the top of the side sill: a crease at z 355 from arch to arch, the sill's face falling to its foot at 125
sections.bumperShutF: the bonnet/bumper line round the nose at z about 455 (centre) dipping to the bumper lamps' tops, running back along the side at z 455-470 to the front arch
sections.tailBandEdge: under the lamp band the bumper's top at z 580-640, a narrow body-colour ledge

rear.shape: round, a slight lip; the opening runs a little long at the foot (3085-3858 at z 320-365)

panels._: the aluminium body's panels, each its own surface meeting the next at a shared edge (for the panel model and for damage later)
panels.1_frontBumper: below the shut line z 455 (nose) / 470 (sides), x 0-575: the long combination lamps at its top corners, the centre intake and two outer intakes (with the fog lamps) below, a thin lip at z 108-130
panels.2_bonnet: the long front lid between the two shut lines (y 357 at x 150 to 452 at the cowl), from the bumper line to the cowl (x 1100); the H badge at its nose
panels.3_popupCovers: x 250-630, y 440-700: each the bonnet-side corner of the nose, flush with the slope when down, hinged at the back edge; raised, a pod about 350 wide and 140 tall faces forward
panels.4_frontWings: from the nose's corners round the covers, over the front wheel to the door's front edge x 1376; their tops meet the bonnet at its shut lines; repeater behind the arch
panels.5_canopy: the black glasshouse: screen (black band round it), black A pillars, black roof panel, door glass, black B pillar garnish behind the glass, quarter glass and the rear glass; it sits on the body colour along the belt and the rear wings' ridges (see the canopy notes)
panels.6_doors: x 1376-2748 at the top; the rear edge curves down and forward to 2422 at the foot (z 208); the soft crease at z 600 runs into the intake
panels.7_sills: z 125-355 under the doors, the crease at 355 on top
panels.8_rearWings: from the door's back edge to the tail: the intake, the fuel flap (left side), the ridge beside the rear glass, the arch; their tops carry the spoiler's ends
panels.9_rearGlass: the engine cover glass, x 2700-3520, hinged at the roof; under it the engine bay
panels.10_bootLid: x 3520-4000 between the rear wings' ridges, nearly flat
panels.11_spoiler: the integrated spoiler bridging the rear wings across the tail, x 3950-4300, top 897
panels.12_tailBand: the full-width smoked black lamp band under the spoiler, z 640-815
panels.13_rearBumper: body colour, z 385-640 face, with the plate recess, wrapping the corners to the rear arches; a black valance with the pipes under it (z 180-385)
panels.14_floor: flat at z 125, wheel wells dark
panels.15_wheels: 1990 cast five-spoke, 15 in front, 16 in rear

canopy._: how the black 'fighter canopy' sits on the body (photos + blueprint side): one black glasshouse on a red lower body
canopy.black: screen frame, A pillars, roof panel (painted black on the 1990 coupe), B pillar garnish (gloss black, flush behind/among the glass; the pillar itself does not show), quarter glass, rear glass, and the trim of the door glass frame
canopy.lowerEdgeSide: the belt line (sections.belt): 745 at the A pillar's foot (x 1250-1376), 732 behind the mirror, 757 mid door, 805 at the B pillar's base (x 2750), 824 at the quarter glass's foot (x 2950); there it steps up onto the rear wing's ridge: the rear glass's side edge runs back at z 880 from x 2990 to its foot
canopy.rearEnd: the canopy ends at the rear glass's foot, x 3520 on the centre line (z 878), the foot curving forward to the sides (plan.rearGlass: y 480 at x 3480, 640 at 3300); behind it the body-colour boot lid; beside it the body-colour ridges of the rear wings, so the black ends as a rounded tongue lying between two red ridges
canopy.bPillar: black garnish x 2687 (top) - 2748 (foot), leaning back; the quarter glass behind it is a triangle up to the slanting edge from (2728, 1117) to (2953, 824), the rear glass seen beyond it
canopy.plan: black from the screen's foot (1110 centre, 1460 at the corners) to the rear glass's foot (3520); the roof's black panel x 1975-2650, half-width 455

tail.spoiler: a body-colour blade rising out of the deck at x 3950 to a flat top at 897, its trailing edge at x 4300 (z 885); in plan it bows forward at the centre (leading edge x 3950 centre, 4150 at y 800) and its ends run into the rear wings' tops (no struts)
tail.gap: between the blade's underside (about 830) and the lamp band's top (about 815) a dark slot shows over the band from behind; from the side the lamp face is set back under the blade (4258 against 4300). Drawn faintly in the blueprint; read as 20-40 tall, +-30
tail.band: full width y +-800 (wing to wing), z 640-815, a smoked black lens leaning forward at the top; lamps inside: amber at the outer ends (y 680-800), red y 260-680, clear reverse y 150-250, a black centre panel y +-140
tail.below: a body-colour ledge (z 580-640) and the bumper face with the plate recess

panels.sideIntake: behind the door: a deep scoop x 2697-2973, z 365-619, its front edge leaning with the door's back edge, its top level, rear and lower corners rounded; it opens back and in about 150 deep; inside dark (a black grille deep in the duct). The fins of the brief were not seen on the 1990 photos: if modelled, 2-3 dark horizontal slats deep inside, not on the surface
panels.fuelFlap: left rear wing only, above and behind the intake: x 2987-3167, z 648-775, a rounded square flush in the skin

engineBay._: transverse C30A V6 (90 deg, DOHC VTEC) behind the seats, under the rear glass; the gearbox on the car's left end of the engine, the differential on the rear axle line

box.note: the space an engine mesh may fill; the rear glass above it falls from z 1126 at x 2800 to 927 at 3400 and 878 at 3520; bulkhead (cabin back) at x 2700 with a small upright cabin window; the boot behind at 3540

engineBay.glassOutline: plan.rearGlass: the clear area x 2720-3500, widest y 690 at x 2850-3050, 480 at 3480

engine.note: block and heads with the crankshaft across the car near x 3150, z 400; the gearbox x 3050-3450 at y -400..-650 (left); +-60

engineBay.visible: through the glass: the cast aluminium intake plenum across the bay with six short runners (x 2950-3250, top z about 800), the rear bank's cam cover (dark, crinkle finish) behind it, an air cleaner box and hoses at the left side (blueprint plan x 3065-3345, y -390..-550), and a bar across the bay's rear (x about 3400, y +-560, bolted at both ends: the strut brace in the blueprint plan); the bay's walls black

colours.paint: #c8102e (Formula Red) gloss; also Berlina Black, Grand Prix White, Sebring Silver
colours.black: canopy (roof panel, pillars, garnish), tail band, lower valances, intakes

versions.1990 NA1: this sheet: pop-up lamps, 3.0 C30A 274 PS (AT about 265 PS), 15/16 in five-spoke wheels, 205/50 and 225/50, black roof, 4405 long, 1170 high, tracks 1510/1530
versions.1992 Type R (JDM): same body, about 120 kg lighter, stiffer, lower (height about 1160), Championship White common; light alloy wheels, no interior trim
versions.1995 NSX-T: targa: removable roof panel (the black roof becomes a lift-out panel), extra stiffening; the coupe phased out in some markets
versions.1997: 3.2 C32B (280 PS JDM, 294 PS Europe), six-speed manual; 16/17 in wheels (215/45 ZR16, 245/40 ZR17); length 4425-4430, rear track 1540
versions.2002 NA2 facelift: fixed HID head lamps (no pop-ups), new front bumper and intakes, revised rear and a higher spoiler lip, 4430 long, 1160 high (the Honda drawing and the Hum3D renders show this car)
versions.photographs: the green Type R photo shows a later car's seven-spoke wheels: use it for the body only
